plugins.name: easyesuite
plugins.description: Operate the EasyEsuite ERP from Claude Cowork — run sales, inventory, and financial reports and drive end-to-end workflows: sales orders, fulfillment, purchasing, invoicing, and marketplace connectors.

skills.name: ap-cash-outlook
skills.description: Build accounts-payable and supplier cash-outlook reports from the EasyEsuite ERP MCP surface. Use when the user wants open bills, partially paid bills, recent vendor payments, AP exposure by vendor, or a near-term cash-out view from bills and bill payments.
skills.description_zh: 通过EasyEsuite ERP生成应付与供应商现金展望，分析未付部分付款账单、近期供应商付款及供应商敞口。

skills.name: ar-collections
skills.description: Build accounts-receivable and collections reports from the EasyEsuite ERP MCP surface. Use when the user wants open invoices, partial-paid invoices, recent payments received, customer collections exposure, or AR aging from invoices and payments.
skills.description_zh: 通过EasyEsuite ERP生成应收与催收报告，分析未结部分付款发票、收款、客户敞口与账龄。

skills.name: building-workflows
skills.description: How to chain EasyEsuite ERP MCP tools into reliable multi-step workflows — resolving names to IDs, handling ambiguous/auto-selected matches, paginating through large result sets, validating before writing, and recovering from errors. Use when a task needs more than one tool call or any create/update/delete on the ERP.
skills.description_zh: 将EasyEsuite ERP工具串成可靠多步流程，处理名称到ID、歧义匹配、分页、写前验证和错误恢复。

skills.name: create-sales-order
skills.description: Create a sales order in the EasyEsuite ERP from a customer, marketplace, warehouse, shipping method, and a list of items — names are resolved to IDs automatically, with serial tracking, discounts/charges, and address overrides supported. Use when the user wants to place, draft, or enter a new sales order.
skills.description_zh: 依据客户、市场、仓库、配送方式与商品创建EasyEsuite销售订单，自动解析名称ID，支持序列号、折扣费用和地址覆盖。

skills.name: customers-and-vendors
skills.description: Manage business contacts and accounts in the EasyEsuite ERP — create and look up customers and vendors, manage financial accounts and banks, and add ERP users. Use when the user wants to onboard a customer/vendor, find an account, or set up a financial account or user.
skills.description_zh: 管理EasyEsuite客户供应商和业务账户，创建查询联系人、设置财务账户与银行，并新增ERP用户。

skills.name: erp-quickstart
skills.description: Foundational reference for the EasyEsuite ERP MCP — how to pick the right tool, the grouped-tool action/id/query/body calling convention, the date-filter rules, pagination via _total_records, and the identifier display rules. Read this before using any other EasyEsuite ERP skill.
headings: 3. Date filters (read every line — this is the #1 source of wrong answers)
skills.description_zh: 作为EasyEsuite ERP基础参考，说明工具选择、分组调用、日期过滤、分页和标识展示规则。

skills.name: financial-reports
skills.description: Build financial reports from the EasyEsuite ERP — accounts receivable (invoices, payments, aging), accounts payable (bills, bill payments), credit memos and refunds, bank/financial-account balances, and account transaction/movement history. Use for questions like "what's outstanding", "AR aging", "payments received this month", or "transactions on account X".
skills.description_zh: 生成EasyEsuite应收应付、账龄、付款、贷项退款、银行余额与交易历史财务报告。

skills.name: fulfill-and-ship-orders
skills.description: Fulfill sales orders in the EasyEsuite ERP and ship them — create fulfillment records, create shipment records, rerate and validate shipments, buy labels, and work with shipment batches. Use when the user wants to ship an order, mark items fulfilled, generate a label, or manage shipment batches.
headings: Step 2 — Create / price / buy the shipment
skills.description_zh: 在EasyEsuite创建履约和运输记录、重新计价校验、购买标签并管理发货批次。

skills.name: inventory-operations
skills.description: Move and adjust stock in the EasyEsuite ERP — transfer inventory between warehouses (create, complete, void transfers) and make manual quantity adjustments (cycle counts, damage, shrinkage, corrections). Use when the user wants to move stock between locations or correct on-hand quantities.
skills.description_zh: 在EasyEsuite仓库间转移库存，创建完成或作废调拨，并按盘点、损坏、损耗或纠错调整数量。

skills.name: inventory-replenishment-report
skills.description: Build replenishment and low-stock reports from the EasyEsuite ERP MCP surface. Use when the user wants reorder candidates, low-stock or out-of-stock items by warehouse, available quantity by location, or a prioritized restock list that can feed purchasing workflows.
skills.description_zh: 生成EasyEsuite补货和低库存报告，按仓库识别缺货、可用量和优先补货候选，供采购流程使用。

skills.name: inventory-reports
skills.description: Report on stock and inventory in the EasyEsuite ERP — on-hand / committed / available quantities by warehouse, low-stock and out-of-stock items, reorder candidates, and per-item availability across locations. Use for questions like "what's low on stock", "how many units of X across warehouses", or "what do we need to reorder".
skills.description_zh: 报告EasyEsuite各仓现有、承诺与可用库存，识别低库存、缺货、重订货及单品跨地点可用性。

skills.name: invoicing-and-payments
skills.description: Invoice sales orders and record customer payments in the EasyEsuite ERP — create invoices (including immediate invoices), apply payments and payment receipts, and pay/settle open invoices. Use when the user wants to bill a customer, record money received, or close out an invoice.

skills.name: manage-catalog-items
skills.description: Create and maintain catalog items in the EasyEsuite ERP — add standard items, kits/bundles, and variant items; update item fields; refresh marketplace configurations for an existing item; and attach product images. Use when the user wants to add a product, build a bundle, configure marketplace data, or update an item.

skills.name: marketplace-connector-ops
skills.description: Operate the narrow Connector V2 MCP surface currently exposed by EasyEsuite — inspect connector account records and carrier mappings. Use when the user wants to review connector account data that is actually available through this plugin.

skills.name: open-orders-aging
skills.description: Build an open-orders aging report from the EasyEsuite ERP MCP surface. Use when the user wants open or pending sales orders bucketed by age, wants to see how old unshipped or uninvoiced orders are, or wants an operational backlog view by status, customer, or marketplace.

skills.name: purchase-order-lifecycle
skills.description: Run the full procurement cycle in the EasyEsuite ERP — create a purchase order from a vendor and items, receive goods against it, generate the vendor bill, and pay it. Also covers expense bills and vendor prepayments. Use when the user wants to raise a PO, restock, receive a shipment, or record/pay a supplier bill.

skills.name: purchasing-reports
skills.description: Report on procurement in the EasyEsuite ERP — purchase order status and counts, open vs. received vs. billed POs, vendor spend, receipts, and outstanding bills. Use for questions like "open POs", "how much did we buy from vendor X", or "what's pending receipt".

skills.name: returns-and-refunds
skills.description: Handle customer returns and refunds in the EasyEsuite ERP — set up a return for a sales order/invoice, process the return refund, issue credit memos and refund against them, and record invoice returns. Use when a customer is returning items or owed money back.
headings: Set up and process a return

skills.name: sales-reports
skills.description: Build sales and revenue reports from the EasyEsuite ERP — order counts and revenue by period, marketplace or status, invoiced vs. fulfilled, top products, and period-over-period comparisons. Use for questions like "how many orders last week", "revenue by marketplace this month", or "what sold best in April".

skills.name: support-tickets
skills.description: Work with Zendesk support tickets surfaced in the EasyEsuite ERP — list and read tickets, inspect the currently exposed tag metadata, and create new tickets. Use when the user asks about support tickets, customer issues, or wants to open a ticket.
